<timestamp>Friday, Sep 18, 2026, 9:17 PM (UTC+5:30)</timestamp>
<user_query>
Build a modern, luxury real estate landing page for a premium property platform 
that serves both buyers/renters AND sellers/landlords.

TECH STACK:
- Next.js 14 (App Router) with TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Framer Motion for subtle animations
- Lucide React for icons
- Use placeholder images from Unsplash (luxury homes)

DESIGN DIRECTION:
- Premium, elegant, minimalist aesthetic
- Color palette: Deep charcoal (#1a1a1a), warm gold accent (#c9a961), 
  soft cream (#f8f5f0), pure white
- Typography: Playfair Display (serif) for headings, Inter (sans-serif) for body
- Generous whitespace, sophisticated feel — think Sotheby's / LuxuryEstate
- Fully responsive (mobile-first)

PAGE STRUCTURE:

1. NAVBAR (sticky, transparent → solid on scroll)
   - Logo: "LUXE ESTATES" (or similar premium name)
   - Links: Buy, Rent, Sell, List Your Property, About, Contact
   - CTA button: "Get Started"

2. HERO SECTION
   - Full-screen background image of a luxury property (with dark overlay)
   - Headline: "Where Exceptional Homes Meet Exceptional People"
   - Subheadline: "Discover, buy, rent, or list the world's most prestigious properties."
   - Below headline: A SEGMENTED TOGGLE / TAB GROUP with 4 tabs:
       • Buy  • Rent  • Sell  • List for Rent
     - When a tab is selected, show relevant search inputs:
       * Buy/Rent → Location, Property Type, Price Range, Bedrooms + "Search" button
       * Sell/List → a short form: "Tell us about your property" + "Get Valuation" button
   - Alternatively, use 2 large toggle buttons: "I want to BUY or RENT" 
     vs "I want to SELL or LIST" that reveal the appropriate form below.

3. DUAL INTENT SECTION (the core of the request)
   Two side-by-side premium cards:
   
   Card A — "For Buyers & Renters"
     - Icon: search home
     - Headline: "Find Your Next Home"
     - Description: Browse handpicked luxury properties for sale and rent.
     - Two CTA buttons: [Buy a Property] [Rent a Property]
   
   Card B — "For Sellers & Landlords"
     - Icon: key / tag
     - Headline: "List Your Property"
     - Description: Reach qualified buyers and tenants seeking premium homes.
     - Two CTA buttons: [Sell My Property] [List for Rent]

4. FEATURED PROPERTIES SECTION
   - Section title: "Featured Listings"
   - Tabs above: [For Sale] [For Rent]
   - Grid of 6 property cards (3 cols desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile)
   - Each card: image, price, title, location, beds/baths/sqft, "For Sale" or "For Rent" badge
   - Hover: subtle scale + gold border

5. WHY CHOOSE US
   - 4 feature cards with icons:
     • Curated Premium Listings
     • Verified Buyers & Tenants
     • Dedicated Concierge Service
     • Transparent Deals

6. HOW IT WORKS (two-column)
   - Left: "For Buyers & Renters" — 3 steps
   - Right: "For Sellers & Landlords" — 3 steps

7. STATS BAR
   - $2B+ in properties sold | 5,000+ premium listings | 98% client satisfaction | 40+ cities

8. TESTIMONIALS
   - 3 cards with client photos, names, and quotes

9. CTA BANNER
   - "Ready to make your move?"
   - Two buttons: [Browse Properties] [List Your Property]

10. FOOTER
    - Logo + tagline
    - Columns: Buy, Rent, Sell, List, About, Contact
    - Social icons, newsletter signup
    - Copyright

INTERACTIONS:
- Smooth scroll between sections
- Tab switching with animated underline
- Fade-in-on-scroll animations (Framer Motion)
- Hover effects on all cards and buttons (gold glow / subtle lift)
- Mobile: hamburger menu, stacked layouts

DELIVERABLES:
- Clean, componentized code (Hero.tsx, DualIntent.tsx, FeaturedProperties.tsx, etc.)
- Reusable Button, Card, Tab components
- Fully responsive
- Accessible (proper ARIA labels on tabs/toggles)
- SEO-friendly metadata

Make it feel like a $10M+ real estate brand — elegant, trustworthy, and premium.
</user_query>
I'll set up a Next.js 14 luxury landing page as a dedicated project, then build the premium sections and components from the spec. First I'm checking how to create the app in this environment.
